steps.title: Define application metadata
steps.description: Establish metadata schema for Expense Tracker Pro containing the official package name com.expensetrackerpro.app inside app-meta.json.

steps.title: Establish build configurations
steps.description: Setup project parameters compatible with Gradle 8.5 and AGP 8.3.2 inside app/build.gradle targeting Android SDK level 34.

steps.title: Configure Application Manifest
steps.description: Formulate AndroidManifest.xml specifying launcher activities, standard material light UI styling, application metadata, and valid package descriptors.

steps.title: Define Color Palette
steps.description: Implement colors.xml containing active green elements for income, vibrant red elements for expenses, and distinct modern category indicators.

steps.title: Define Localized Strings
steps.description: Add user-facing text variables inside strings.xml ensuring language variables match transaction operations.

steps.title: Implement Custom Card Backgrounds
steps.description: Create shape drawable card_bg.xml to produce rounded borders for transaction containers and summary dashboards.

steps.title: Implement Interactive Buttons Styling
steps.description: Provide custom drawables edit_text_bg.xml, button_bg.xml, and button_accent_bg.xml for streamlined button outlines.

steps.title: Program SQLite Database Helper
steps.description: Create DatabaseHelper.java employing Android built-in SQL compilation systems to map transactions tables and record operations.

steps.title: Construct Transaction Data Model
steps.description: Implement the core Transaction.java representation mapping types, dates, description, categories, and numerical totals.

steps.title: Build Custom PieChartView Graphic Component
steps.description: Create PieChartView.java drawing responsive donut pie charts with descriptive inner labels and custom arc slices.

steps.title: Construct Main User Interface
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml layout structuring multi-tab dashboard layouts, history listings, reports tabs, and active tab triggers.

steps.title: Design Dialog Insertion Screen
steps.description: Formulate dialog_add_transaction.xml incorporating category selectors, numeric inputs, calendar dialog triggers, and text notes.

steps.title: Construct Transaction Row Items
steps.description: Create item_transaction.xml representing individual listings showing categorizations, color type lines, and deletion shortcuts.

steps.title: Construct Report Categories Breakdowns
steps.description: Create item_category_breakdown.xml supporting individual list aggregates in report charts detailing relative percentage distributions.

steps.title: Develop Core Logic & Tab Controller
steps.description: Implement MainActivity.java tying local transactions database operations, data calculations, dynamic spinners, custom lists, filters, and reports.

steps.title: Building Expense Tracker Pro
steps.description: Execute compile assembly, build resources, perform static analysis checks, verify namespaces, and complete build.
